guideline.description: Structural claims take no statement_role and are asserted (guideline §10.3, §10.6).
A claim's statement_role is one its statement's kind gives (guideline §10.3).
guideline.when: not ('structural' in claim.groups) and claim.statement_kind != null

guideline.description: A claim's modality follows from its statement_role (guideline §10.6).
guideline.when: not ('structural' in claim.groups) and claim.statement_role != null

guideline.description: Structural claims carry no conditions (guideline §10.7 rule 4).

guideline.check:
$all([n.op == 'and' or (n.op == 'member' and (n.x_latex ?? '') in claim.subject.index_symbols)
      for n in claim.condition_nodes])
guideline.description: Premises and example values carry no conditions except the range of an index they are stated for; restrictions go to the claims that depend on them (guideline §10.7 rule 1).
guideline.when: not ('structural' in claim.groups) and claim.statement_role in ['premise', 'example_value']

guideline.description: Formula and family-structure claims carry no claim nodes, only restrictions on their own symbols (guideline §10.7 rule 2).

guideline.check: claim.statement_premises.is_empty or $any([p in claim.claim_refs for p in claim.statement_premises])
guideline.description: Every other claim carries a claim node for the premises it depends on: it references at least one premise of its statement or of a context-premise assumption (guideline §10.7 rule 3).
guideline.when:
not ('structural' in claim.groups or 'formula_definition' in claim.groups
     or 'family_structure' in claim.groups)
and not (claim.statement_role in ['premise', 'example_value'])

guideline.description: A parameter_role claim is stated only when the role differs from the canonical name (guideline §10.4).
A formula that defines a variable or generates a family excludes the variable it defines (guideline §10.7).
Symbol-map keys are written without backslash (guideline §10.7).

guideline.check:
$all([not (b.symbol in claim.given_by_others and b.bind in ['free', 'family_param']
           and not (b.symbol in claim.gives_symbols)
           and not ('family_structure' in claim.groups and b.bind == 'family_param'))
      for b in claim.bindings])
guideline.description: A symbol another claim gives as a parameter value binds param_of, not free or family_param, unless the claim is about the family as such (guideline §10.7 rows 2-4).

rules.check:
$all([k in claim.family_params or k in $enums['ParameterRole']
      for k in (claim.qualifiers.param_values ?? {}).keys])
rules.description: Every param_values key is the canonical name of a parameter the family has in this run, or a ParameterRole value. A family's parameters are complete only at finalize.

rules.check: $all([o in claim.alternative_of for o in claim.same_slot])
rules.description: At most one asserted or defined stated has_distribution per variable per statement, unless the claims are marked as alternatives; derived claims are exempt.
The object parses as a set (parse ok under the set kind); otherwise a warning, and the object is kept as written. Reads the grammar's parse status, so it runs at finalize only.
The subject of has_parameter is not a random variable. Subsumed by the predicate's domain (Parameterized) once the side-table type check runs; kept as the check of the $is_a builtin.
